metadata.description: Skill buckets for the pragmatic programmer: software craft, cryptographic security, user experience. Add once, install the buckets you want.

plugins.name: pragmatic-programmer
plugins.description: Small sharp skills distilled from Hunt & Thomas's Pragmatic Programmer and Eric S. Raymond's Art of Unix Programming — decision-making, debugging, hygiene, defensive design, Unix-style composition.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Cryptographic audit and migration skills: Nadim Kobeissi's Post-Quantum Migration Playbook (pqc-*) and mpcsec.org's MPC / threshold-cryptography audit checklist. Composes with the pragmatic-programmer bucket.

plugins.name: user-experience
plugins.description: Retention, referral, outbound sales and SEO skills — distilled and rewritten from mayurrathi/awesome-agent-skills.
